items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: not after '67, when George Reed and Longhorn Texas situation in Austin, and put us together.

ctx.x: Is he original as well as he ghosts copies?

Oh yeah, he's original; he's got good ideas. He ain't no slouch. he can play. But I'm gonna say this, and I hope it gets back to him --he don't want never wanted to play with me, and we've had all the opportunities to play together to make money as a commercial situation, but he refuses. My right man here in the club wanted him down here and I tried to get him to New York; nobody answered his phone and I wanted to talk to him personally myself.
